name: Phoenix Paradise
review:
Explorer Jeanette in the jungle, on a 3x5 grid with 15 lines. Wilds, wild payline multipliers, mystery wild activation and a walking wild all drive the action.

The goal is to collect the three phoenix eggs, and the walking wild can sweep across several winning lines. Payline multipliers boost every line a wild completes. High volatility, 10,000x cap, 96.13% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
